faq.question: Who is Plainly best for?
faq.answer: Plainly is built for teams of 5–100 people that want repeatable workflows without per-seat pricing or a long implementation project.

faq.question: Is this comparison independent?
faq.answer: No. Plainly publishes this page. We show the criteria, mark areas where competitors lead, and recommend verifying current pricing and features before buying.

faq.question: Can we migrate our existing data?
faq.answer: Yes. Plainly accepts CSV and JSON imports. The team provides a field-mapping review on every paid plan.

faq.question: Why does Orbit win on integrations?
faq.answer: Orbit lists more maintained native integrations than Plainly. If a specific native connector is essential, Orbit may be the better fit.

faq.question: Can we try Plainly before committing?
faq.answer: Yes. Email the team for a guided 14-day workspace with your own workflow and no credit card.
